Private Sub partnerName_Click()
Dim frmName As String, frm As Form

  frmName = "frmAccARAP"
    If Application.SysCmd(acSysCmdGetObjectState, acForm, frmName) Then
      Set frm = Forms!frmAccARAP!frmAccARAP_Sums.Form
      DoCmd.Echo False
      frm.Filter = "partnerName Like '*" & Me!partnerName & "*'"
      If Not frm.FilterOn Then frm.FilterOn = True
      DoCmd.Echo True
    Else
      Beep
      MsgBox "Saldakonti niso odprti.", vbInformation
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Report_Open(Cancel As Integer)
Dim strSQL As String, rs As DAO.Recordset

Exit Sub

  strSQL = "SELECT tblAccVat_VatSettlementTypes.vatExemptionClauseSLO AS clause, 0 AS vatRate0 " & _
           "FROM tblAccVat_VatSettlementTypes INNER JOIN tblOfficeInvoices ON tblAccVat_VatSettlementTypes.vatSettlementTypeID = tblOfficeInvoices.vatSettlementTypeID " & _
           "WHERE (((tblAccVat_VatSettlementTypes.appliedToInvoice)=True) AND ((tblAccVat_VatSettlementTypes.isExemption)=True) AND " & _
           "((([officeInvoiceID]))=" & ([Forms]![frmOfficeInvoice].[Form]![officeInvoiceID]) & "));"

  Set rs = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset(strSQL)
  If rs.RecordCount = 0 Then
    Me.RecordSource = "qryOfficeInvoiceTaxExemptionsDet"
  Else
    Me.RecordSource = "qryOfficeInvoiceTaxExemptionsInv"
  End If
  
End Sub

Private Sub Detail_Format(Cancel As Integer, FormatCount As Integer)
On Error Resume Next
  If Me!is_active = True Then
    Me!ln.ForeColor = 2500134
    Me!product_name.ForeColor = 2500134
    Me!sales_price.ForeColor = 2500134
    Me!purchase_price.ForeColor = 2500134
    Me!purchase_price1.ForeColor = 2500134
    Me!RVC.ForeColor = 2500134
    Me!WE.ForeColor = 2500134
  Else
    Me!ln.ForeColor = 10921638
    Me!product_name.ForeColor = 10921638
    Me!sales_price.ForeColor = 10921638
    Me!purchase_price.ForeColor = 10921638
    Me!purchase_price1.ForeColor = 10921638
    Me!RVC.ForeColor = 10921638
    Me!WE.ForeColor = 10921638
  End If
  
  If IsNumeric(Me!WE) And Me!WE >= 1 Then Me!WE.ForeColor = 255
End Sub
